name: Gwyneth Claremont
source:
The Princess of Volcano Kingdom, but she hates to be addressed as such. She is working hard to become the heir and proactively participates in both politics and military affairs.

The only person she trusts around her is her brother. She doesn't expect him to ever be completely normal again but still hopes he has a safe life.

She rarely has time for fun; when she isn't studying she's accomplishing missions. She hopes she can find a way to lead the Kingdom into a better future through history and hopes Rose can be part of her journey.

[Edited from in-game bio]
